title: Har darood aur har salaam
body:
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
tapti wo zameene karbala
teero se channi badan hua
sajda wo tere hussain ka
hashr tak na bhoola jayega
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Pota tera che mahine ka
isne kaam kaisa kardiya
jab laga hai teere hurmala
zere lab hai muskuradiya
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo tera Abbase bawafa
jispe ki layeeno ne jafa par alam ko girne na diya
Mashke sakina ko bhar liya
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Mashk chidi paani behgaya
shaane kate gore se gira
Gazi ne tab sheh ko di nida
kehta raha aayiye moula
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhai ko bhai ne dekha
kaise kahu baat kya hua
naame wafa zinda kargaya
haaye Alamdar margaya
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek aur pota wo tera
jo bana tha ran me dulha
iska tukde hogaya lasha
teri poti hogayi bewa
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Tera Akbar mailaqa
barcchi ka phal seene pa khaaya
Aediyaa ragadne wo laga
baap dekhta hi rehgaya
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis tarah bayaa'n kare koi
Aah shah ki wo bekasi
kaise uthe lash bete ki
roti thi nehre furaat bhi
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaffare tayyar ke pote aur the zainab ke laadle
ladte ladte tere nawaase
hogaye qurbaan wo pyaare
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
teri bahu aur betiyaa'n
phirti thi dar dar kaha kaha'n
Berida thi shahzadiyaa'n
Aisi qaidi aur wo zindaa'n
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Tera pota abide bimaar
bediyaa'n aur touq qardaar
zulm o sitam the beshumar phir bhi lab pe shukre kirdegaar
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri wo mazloom sakina
gham se bhara jiska tha seena
maarta tha shimr kamina
Baliya'n bhi baccchi ki cheena
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad karke pidar ko
kehti thi Hamesha wo roro
marti hoon mai baba kaha ho
haal mera aake to dekho
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainabe dukhiya teri beti
Kaam wo azeem kargayi
Har jagah wi khutbe sunaati
Ali Nabi Hussain bangayi
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindabaad Abbas Ka Alam
Zindabaad hussain ka ye gham
Hashr talak shahzadi hum
karte rahe shah ka matam
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai zaheer tumse multaji
nazre karam humpe ho bibi
shah ke gham ke siwa kabhi
koi gham na ho mile khusi
<<MINI>>
Har darood aur har salaam
Madare Hussain tere naam
